speaker: david-servants
text: Let us search for a young virgin for our lord the king, to attend to him and care for him and lie by his side to keep him warm.
name: David's servants

speaker: adonijah
text: I will be king!
name: Adonijah

speaker: nathan
text: Have you not heard that Adonijah son of Haggith has become king, and our lord David does not know it?
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Now please, come and let me advise you. Save your own life and the life of your son Solomon.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Go at once to King David and say, ‘My lord the king, did you not swear to your maidservant, “Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne”? Why then has Adonijah become king?’
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Then, while you are still there speaking with the king, I will come in after you and confirm your words.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: david
text: What is your desire?
name: David

speaker: bathsheba
text: My lord,
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: you yourself swore to your maidservant by the LORD your God: ‘Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne.’
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: But now, behold, Adonijah has become king, and you, my lord the king, did not know it.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: And he has sacrificed an abundance of oxen, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the other sons of the king, as well as Abiathar the priest and Joab the commander of the army. But he did not invite your servant Solomon.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: And as for you, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are upon you to tell them who will sit on the throne of my lord the king after him.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: Otherwise, when my lord the king rests with his fathers, I and my son Solomon will be counted as criminals.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Nathan the prophet is here.
name: An informant

speaker: nathan
text: My lord the king,
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: did you say, ‘Adonijah will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne’?
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: For today he has gone down and sacrificed an abundance of oxen, fattened calves, and sheep, and has invited all the sons of the king, the commanders of the army, and Abiathar the priest. And behold, they are eating and drinking before him, saying, ‘Long live King Adonijah!’
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: But me your servant he did not invite, nor Zadok the priest, nor Benaiah son of Jehoiada, nor your servant Solomon.
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: nathan
text: Has my lord the king let this happen without informing your servant who should sit on the throne after my lord the king?
name: Nathan the prophet

speaker: david
text: Call in Bathsheba for me.
name: David

speaker: david
text: As surely as the LORD lives, who has redeemed my life from all distress,
name: David

speaker: david
text: I will carry out this very day exactly what I swore to you by the LORD, the God of Israel: Surely your son Solomon will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne in my place.
name: David

speaker: bathsheba
text: May my lord King David live forever!
name: Bathsheba

speaker: david
text: Call in for me Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Take my servants with you,
name: David

speaker: david
text: Set my son Solomon on my own mule and take him down to Gihon.
name: David

speaker: david
text: There Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet are to anoint him king over Israel. You are to blow the ram’s horn and declare, ‘Long live King Solomon!’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Then you shall go up with him, and he is to come and sit on my throne and reign in my place. For I have appointed him ruler over Israel and Judah.
name: David

speaker: benaiah
text: Amen,
name: Benaiah

speaker: benaiah
text: May the LORD, the God of my lord the king, so declare it.
name: Benaiah

speaker: benaiah
text: Just as the LORD was with my lord the king, so may He be with Solomon and make his throne even greater than that of my lord King David.
name: Benaiah

speaker: israelites
text: Long live King Solomon!
name: The people

speaker: joab
text: Why is the city in such a loud uproar?
name: Joab

speaker: adonijah
text: Come in,
name: Adonijah

speaker: adonijah
text: for you are a man of valor. You must be bringing good news.
name: Adonijah

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: Not at all,
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: Our lord King David has made Solomon king.
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: And with Solomon, the king has sent Zadok the priest, Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah son of Jehoiada, along with the Cherethites and Pelethites, and they have set him on the king’s mule.
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet have anointed him king at Gihon, and they have gone up from there with rejoicing that rings out in the city. That is the noise you hear.
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: Moreover, Solomon has taken his seat on the royal throne.
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king has bowed in worship on his bed,
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: jonathan-son-of-abiathar
text: saying, ‘Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel! Today He has provided one to sit on my throne, and my eyes have seen it.’
name: Jonathan son of Abiathar

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Behold, Adonijah fears King Solomon, and he has taken hold of the horns of the altar, saying, ‘Let King Solomon first swear to me not to put his servant to the sword.’
name: An informant

speaker: solomon
text: If he is a man of character, not a single hair of his will fall to the ground. But if evil is found in him, he will die.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Go to your home.
name: Solomon

speaker: david
text: I am about to go the way of all the earth. So be strong and prove yourself a man.
name: David

speaker: david
text: And keep the charge of the LORD your God to walk in His ways and to keep His statutes, commandments, ordinances, and decrees, as is written in the Law of Moses, so that you may prosper in all you do and wherever you turn,
name: David

speaker: david
text: and so that the LORD may fulfill His promise to me: ‘If your descendants take heed to walk faithfully before Me with all their heart and soul, you will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Moreover, you know what Joab son of Zeruiah did to me—what he did to Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of the armies of Israel. He killed them in peacetime to avenge the blood of war. He stained with the blood of war the belt around his waist and the sandals on his feet.
name: David

speaker: david
text: So act according to your wisdom, and do not let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
name: David

speaker: david
text: But show loving devotion to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be among those who eat at your table, because they stood by me when I fled from your brother Absalom.
name: David

speaker: david
text: Keep an eye on Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim who is with you. He called down bitter curses against me on the day I went to Mahanaim, but when he came down to meet me at the Jordan, I swore to him by the LORD: ‘I will never put you to the sword.’
name: David

speaker: david
text: Now therefore, do not hold him guiltless, for you are a wise man. You know what you ought to do to him to bring his gray head down to Sheol in blood.
name: David

speaker: bathsheba
text: Do you come in peace?
name: Bathsheba

speaker: adonijah
text: Yes, in peace,
name: Adonijah

speaker: adonijah
text: I have something to tell you.
name: Adonijah

speaker: bathsheba
text: Say it,
name: Bathsheba

speaker: adonijah
text: You know that the kingship was mine,
name: Adonijah

speaker: adonijah
text: All Israel expected that I should reign, but the kingship has turned to my brother, for it has come to him from the LORD.
name: Adonijah

speaker: adonijah
text: So now I have just one request of you; do not deny me.
name: Adonijah

speaker: bathsheba
text: State your request,
name: Bathsheba

speaker: adonijah
text: Please speak to King Solomon, since he will not turn you down. Let him give me Abishag the Shunammite as my wife.
name: Adonijah

speaker: bathsheba
text: Very well,
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: I will speak to the king for you.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: I have just one small request of you,
name: Bathsheba

speaker: bathsheba
text: Do not deny me.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: solomon
text: Make your request, my mother,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: for I will not deny you.
name: Solomon

speaker: bathsheba
text: Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to your brother Adonijah as his wife.
name: Bathsheba

speaker: solomon
text: Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Since he is my older brother, you might as well request the kingdom for him and for Abiathar the priest and for Joab son of Zeruiah!
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May God punish me, and ever so severely, if Adonijah has not made this request at the expense of his life.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And now, as surely as the LORD lives—the One who established me, who set me on the throne of my father David, and who founded for me a dynasty as He promised—surely Adonijah shall be put to death today!
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Go back to your fields in Anathoth. Even though you deserve to die, I will not put you to death at this time, since you carried the ark of the Lord GOD before my father David, and you suffered through all that my father suffered.
name: Solomon

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Joab has fled to the tent of the LORD and is now beside the altar.
name: An informant

speaker: solomon
text: Go, strike him down!
name: Solomon

speaker: benaiah
text: The king says, ‘Come out!’
name: Benaiah

speaker: joab
text: No, I will die here.
name: Joab

speaker: benaiah
text: This is how Joab answered me.
name: Benaiah

speaker: solomon
text: Do just as he says. Strike him down and bury him, and so remove from me and from the house of my father the innocent blood that Joab shed.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: The LORD will bring his bloodshed back upon his own head, for without the knowledge of my father David he struck down two men more righteous and better than he when he put to the sword Abner son of Ner, commander of Israel’s army, and Amasa son of Jether, commander of Judah’s army.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Their blood will come back upon the heads of Joab and his descendants forever; but for David, his descendants, his house, and his throne, there shall be peace from the LORD forever.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Build a house for yourself in Jerusalem and live there, but do not go anywhere else.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: On the day you go out and cross the Kidron Valley, know for sure that you will die; your blood will be on your own head.
name: Solomon

speaker: shimei
text: The sentence is fair,
name: Shimei

speaker: shimei
text: Your servant will do as my lord the king has spoken.
name: Shimei

speaker: unnamed-informant
text: Look, your slaves are in Gath.
name: An informant

speaker: solomon
text: Did I not make you swear by the LORD and warn you, ‘On the day you leave and go elsewhere, know for sure that you will die’? And you told me, ‘The sentence is fair; I will comply.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: So why have you not kept your oath to the LORD and the command that I gave you?
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: You know in your heart all the evil that you did to my father David. Therefore the LORD will bring your evil back upon your head.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But King Solomon will be blessed and David’s throne will remain secure before the LORD forever.
name: Solomon

speaker: god
text: Ask, and I will give it to you!
name: The LORD

speaker: solomon
text: You have shown much loving devotion to Your servant, my father David, because he walked before You in faithfulness, righteousness, and uprightness of heart. And You have maintained this loving devotion by giving him a son to sit on his throne this very day.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And now, O LORD my God, You have made Your servant king in my father David’s place. But I am only a little child, not knowing how to go out or come in.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Your servant is here among the people You have chosen, a people too numerous to count or number.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Therefore give Your servant an understanding heart to judge Your people and to discern between good and evil. For who is able to govern this great people of Yours?
name: Solomon

speaker: god
text: Since you have asked for this instead of requesting long life or wealth for yourself or death for your enemies—but you have asked for discernment to administer justice—
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: behold, I will do what you have asked. I will give you a wise and discerning heart, so that there has never been nor will ever be another like you.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Moreover, I will give you what you did not request—both riches and honor—so that during all your days no man in any kingdom will be your equal.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So if you walk in My ways and keep My statutes and commandments, just as your father David did, I will prolong your days.
name: The LORD

speaker: prostitute-1
text: Please, my lord, this woman and I live in the same house, and I gave birth while she was in the house.
name: The first woman

speaker: prostitute-1
text: On the third day after I gave birth, this woman also had a baby. We were alone, with no one in the house but the two of us.
name: The first woman

speaker: prostitute-1
text: During the night this woman’s son died because she rolled over on him.
name: The first woman

speaker: prostitute-1
text: So she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while I was asleep. She laid him in her bosom and put her dead son at my bosom.
name: The first woman

speaker: prostitute-1
text: The next morning, when I got up to nurse my son, I discovered he was dead. But when I examined him, I realized that he was not the son I had borne.
name: The first woman

speaker: prostitute-2
text: No,
name: The second woman

speaker: prostitute-2
text: the living one is my son and the dead one is your son.
name: The second woman

speaker: prostitute-1
text: No, the dead one is yours and the living one is mine.
name: The first woman

speaker: solomon
text: This woman says, ‘My son is alive and yours is dead,’ but that woman says, ‘No, your son is dead and mine is alive.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Bring me a sword.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Cut the living child in two and give half to one and half to the other.
name: Solomon

speaker: real-mother
text: Please, my lord,
name: The child's true mother

speaker: real-mother
text: give her the living baby. Do not kill him!
name: The child's true mother

speaker: false-mother
text: He will be neither mine nor yours. Cut him in two!
name: The other woman

speaker: solomon
text: Give the living baby to the first woman. By no means should you kill him; she is his mother.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: As you are well aware, due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David, he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD had put his enemies under his feet.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: So behold, I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God, according to what the LORD said to my father David: ‘I will put your son on your throne in your place, and he will build the house for My Name.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now therefore, order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me. My servants will be with your servants, and I will pay your servants whatever wages you set, for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.
name: Solomon

speaker: hiram
text: Blessed be the LORD this day! He has given David a wise son over this great people!
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: I have received your message; I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: hiram
text: My servants will haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate the logs, and you can take them away. And in exchange, you can meet my needs by providing my household with food.
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: god
text: As for this temple you are building, if you walk in My statutes, carry out My ordinances, and keep all My commandments by walking in them, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father David.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And I will dwell among the Israelites and will not abandon My people Israel.
name: The LORD

speaker: solomon
text: The LORD has said that He would dwell in the thick cloud.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: I have indeed built You an exalted house, a place for You to dwell forever.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, who has fulfilled with His own hand what He spoke with His mouth to my father David, saying,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: ‘Since the day I brought My people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from any tribe of Israel in which to build a house so that My Name would be there. But I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now it was in the heart of my father David to build a house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Nevertheless, you are not the one to build it; but your son, your own offspring, will build the house for My Name.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Now the LORD has fulfilled the word that He spoke. I have succeeded my father David, and I sit on the throne of Israel, as the LORD promised. I have built the house for the Name of the LORD, the God of Israel.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And there I have provided a place for the ark, which contains the covenant of the LORD that He made with our fathers when He brought them out of the land of Egypt.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: O LORD, God of Israel, there is no God like You in heaven above or on earth below, keeping Your covenant of loving devotion with Your servants who walk before You with all their hearts.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: You have kept Your promise to Your servant, my father David. What You spoke with Your mouth You have fulfilled with Your hand this day.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Therefore now, O LORD, God of Israel, keep for Your servant, my father David, what You promised when You said: ‘You will never fail to have a man to sit before Me on the throne of Israel, if only your descendants guard their way to walk before Me as you have done.’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And now, O God of Israel, please confirm what You promised to Your servant, my father David.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: But will God indeed dwell upon the earth? Even heaven, the highest heaven, cannot contain You, much less this temple I have built.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Yet regard the prayer and plea of Your servant, O LORD my God, so that You may hear the cry and the prayer that Your servant is praying before You today.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May Your eyes be open toward this temple night and day, toward the place of which You said, ‘My Name shall be there,’ so that You may hear the prayer that Your servant prays toward this place.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Hear the plea of Your servant and of Your people Israel when they pray toward this place. May You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place. May You hear and forgive.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When a man sins against his neighbor and is required to take an oath, and he comes to take an oath before Your altar in this temple,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven and act. May You judge Your servants, condemning the wicked man by bringing down on his own head what he has done, and justifying the righteous man by rewarding him according to his righteousness.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When Your people Israel are defeated before an enemy because they have sinned against You, and they return to You and confess Your name, praying and pleading with You in this temple,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your people Israel. May You restore them to the land You gave to their fathers.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When the skies are shut and there is no rain because Your people have sinned against You, and they pray toward this place and confess Your name, and they turn from their sins because You have afflicted them,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven and forgive the sin of Your servants, Your people Israel, so that You may teach them the good way in which they should walk. May You send rain on the land that You gave Your people as an inheritance.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When famine or plague comes upon the land, or blight or mildew or locusts or grasshoppers, or when their enemy besieges them in their cities, whatever plague or sickness may come,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may whatever prayer or petition Your people Israel make—each knowing his own afflictions and spreading out his hands toward this temple—
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: be heard by You from heaven, Your dwelling place. And may You forgive and act, and repay each man according to all his ways, since You know his heart—for You alone know the hearts of all men—
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: so that they may fear You all the days they live in the land that You gave to our fathers.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And as for the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel but has come from a distant land because of Your name—
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: for they will hear of Your great name and mighty hand and outstretched arm—when he comes and prays toward this temple,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, and do according to all for which the foreigner calls to You. Then all the peoples of the earth will know Your name and fear You, as do Your people Israel, and they will know that this house I have built is called by Your Name.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When Your people go to war against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to the LORD in the direction of the city You have chosen and the house I have built for Your Name,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven their prayer and their plea, and may You uphold their cause.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: When they sin against You—for there is no one who does not sin—and You become angry with them and deliver them to an enemy who takes them as captives to his own land, whether far or near,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: and when they come to their senses in the land to which they were taken, and they repent and plead with You in the land of their captors, saying, ‘We have sinned and done wrong; we have acted wickedly,’
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: and when they return to You with all their heart and soul in the land of the enemies who took them captive, and when they pray to You in the direction of the land that You gave to their fathers, the city You have chosen, and the house I have built for Your Name,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: then may You hear from heaven, Your dwelling place, their prayer and petition, and may You uphold their cause.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May You forgive Your people who have sinned against You and all the transgressions they have committed against You, and may You grant them compassion in the eyes of their captors to show them mercy.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: For they are Your people and Your inheritance; You brought them out of Egypt, out of the furnace for iron.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May Your eyes be open to the pleas of Your servant and of Your people Israel, and may You listen to them whenever they call to You.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: For You, O Lord GOD, as Your inheritance, have set them apart from all the peoples of the earth, as You spoke through Your servant Moses when You brought our fathers out of Egypt.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: Blessed be the LORD, who has given rest to His people Israel according to all that He promised. Not one word has failed of all the good promises He made through His servant Moses.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May the LORD our God be with us, as He was with our fathers. May He never leave us nor forsake us.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: May He incline our hearts to Himself, to walk in all His ways and to keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances He commanded our fathers.
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: And may these words with which I have made my petition before the LORD be near to the LORD our God day and night, so that He may uphold the cause of His servant and of His people Israel as each day requires,
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: so that all the peoples of the earth may know that the LORD is God. There is no other!
name: Solomon

speaker: solomon
text: So let your heart be fully devoted to the LORD our God, as it is this day, to walk in His statutes and to keep His commandments.
name: Solomon

speaker: god
text: I have heard your prayer and petition before Me. I have consecrated this temple you have built by putting My Name there forever; My eyes and My heart will be there for all time.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And as for you, if you walk before Me as your father David walked, with a heart of integrity and uprightness, doing all I have commanded you, and if you keep My statutes and ordinances,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I will establish your royal throne over Israel forever, as I promised your father David when I said, ‘You will never fail to have a man on the throne of Israel.’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: But if indeed you or your sons turn away from following Me and do not keep the commandments and statutes I have set before you, and if you go off to serve and worship other gods,
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: then I will cut off Israel from the land that I have given them, and I will banish from My presence this temple I have sanctified for My Name. Then Israel will become an object of scorn and ridicule among all peoples.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And when this temple has become a heap of rubble, all who pass by it will be appalled and will hiss and say, ‘Why has the LORD done such a thing to this land and to this temple?’
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And others will answer, ‘Because they have forsaken the LORD their God who brought their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have embraced other gods, worshiping and serving them—because of this, the LORD has brought all this disaster upon them.’
name: The LORD

speaker: hiram
text: What are these towns you have given me, my brother?
name: Hiram king of Tyre

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: The report I heard in my own country about your words and wisdom is true.
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: But I did not believe these things until I came and saw with my own eyes. Indeed, not even half was told to me. Your wisdom and prosperity have far exceeded the report I heard.
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: How blessed are your men! How blessed are these servants of yours who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom!
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: queen-of-sheba
text: Blessed be the LORD your God, who has delighted in you to set you on the throne of Israel. Because of the LORD’s eternal love for Israel, He has made you king to carry out justice and righteousness.
name: The queen of Sheba

speaker: god
text: You must not intermarry with them, for surely they will turn your hearts after their gods.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Because you have done this and have not kept My covenant and My statutes, which I have commanded you, I will tear the kingdom away from you and give it to your servant.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Nevertheless, for the sake of your father David, I will not do it during your lifetime; I will tear it out of the hand of your son.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Yet I will not tear the whole kingdom away from him. I will give one tribe to your son for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, which I have chosen.
name: The LORD

speaker: hadad
text: Let me go, that I may return to my own country.
name: Hadad the Edomite

speaker: pharaoh
text: What have you lacked here with me that you suddenly want to go back to your own country?
name: Pharaoh

speaker: hadad
text: Nothing,
name: Hadad the Edomite

speaker: hadad
text: but please let me go.
name: Hadad the Edomite

speaker: ahijah
text: Take ten pieces for yourself, for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Behold, I will tear the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and I will give you ten tribes.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: But one tribe will remain for the sake of My servant David and for the sake of Jerusalem, the city I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: For they have forsaken Me to worship Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the Ammonites. They have not walked in My ways, nor done what is right in My eyes, nor kept My statutes and judgments, as Solomon’s father David did.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: Nevertheless, I will not take the whole kingdom out of Solomon’s hand, because I have made him ruler all the days of his life for the sake of David My servant, whom I chose because he kept My commandments and statutes.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: But I will take ten tribes of the kingdom from the hand of his son and give them to you.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: I will give one tribe to his son, so that My servant David will always have a lamp before Me in Jerusalem, the city where I chose to put My Name.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: But as for you, I will take you, and you shall reign over all that your heart desires, and you will be king over Israel.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: If you listen to all that I command you, walk in My ways, and do what is right in My sight in order to keep My statutes and commandments as My servant David did, then I will be with you. I will build you a lasting dynasty just as I built for David, and I will give Israel to you.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: Because of this, I will humble David’s descendants—but not forever.’
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: israelites
text: Your father put a heavy yoke on us. But now you should lighten the burden of your father’s service and the heavy yoke he put on us, and we will serve you.
name: The people

speaker: rehoboam
text: Go away for three days and then return to me.
name: Rehoboam

speaker: rehoboam
text: How do you advise me to respond to these people?
name: Rehoboam

speaker: elders
text: If you will be a servant to these people and serve them this day, and if you will respond by speaking kind words to them, they will be your servants forever.
name: The elders

speaker: rehoboam
text: What message do you advise that we send back to these people who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke your father put on us’?
name: Rehoboam

speaker: young-men
text: This is how you should answer these people who said to you, ‘Your father made our yoke heavy, but you should make it lighter.’ This is what you should tell them: ‘My little finger is thicker than my father’s waist!
name: The young men

speaker: young-men
text: Whereas my father burdened you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.’
name: The young men

speaker: rehoboam
text: Come back to me on the third day.
name: Rehoboam

speaker: rehoboam
text: Whereas my father made your yoke heavy, I will add to your yoke. Whereas my father scourged you with whips, I will scourge you with scorpions.
name: Rehoboam

speaker: israelites
text: What portion do we have in David, and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? To your tents, O Israel! Look now to your own house, O David!
name: The people

speaker: god
text: Tell Rehoboam son of Solomon king of Judah, all the house of Judah and Benjamin, and the rest of the people
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: that this is what the LORD says: ‘You are not to go up and fight against your brothers, the Israelites. Each of you must return home, for this word is from Me.’
name: The LORD

speaker: jeroboam
text: Now the kingdom might revert to the house of David.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: jeroboam
text: If these people go up to offer sacrifices in the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, their hearts will return to their lord, Rehoboam king of Judah; then they will kill me and return to Rehoboam king of Judah.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: jeroboam
text: Going up to Jerusalem is too much for you. Here, O Israel, are your gods, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: man-of-god
text: O altar, O altar, this is what the LORD says: ‘A son named Josiah will be born to the house of David, and upon you he will sacrifice the priests of the high places who burn incense upon you, and human bones will be burned upon you.’
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: man-of-god
text: The LORD has spoken this sign: ‘Surely the altar will be split apart, and the ashes upon it will be poured out.’
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: jeroboam
text: Seize him!
name: Jeroboam

speaker: jeroboam
text: Intercede with the LORD your God and pray that my hand may be restored.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: jeroboam
text: Come home with me and refresh yourself, and I will give you a reward.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: man-of-god
text: If you were to give me half your possessions, I still would not go with you, nor would I eat bread or drink water in this place.
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: man-of-god
text: For this is what I was commanded by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water or return by the way you came.’
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: old-prophet
text: Which way did he go?
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: Saddle the donkey for me.
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: Are you the man of God who came from Judah?
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: man-of-god
text: I am,
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: old-prophet
text: Come home with me and eat some bread.
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: man-of-god
text: I cannot return with you or eat bread or drink water with you in this place.
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: man-of-god
text: For I have been told by the word of the LORD: ‘You must not eat bread or drink water there or return by the way you came.’
name: The man of God from Judah

speaker: old-prophet
text: I too am a prophet like you, and an angel spoke to me by the word of the LORD, saying, ‘Bring him back with you to your house, so that he may eat bread and drink water.’
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Because you have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept the commandment that the LORD your God gave you,
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: but you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so, your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers.’
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD. Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion, and it has mauled him and killed him, according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him.
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: Saddle the donkey for me.
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: Oh, my brother!
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: When I die, you must bury me in the tomb where the man of God is buried. Lay my bones beside his bones,
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: old-prophet
text: for the message that he cried out by the word of the LORD against the altar in Bethel and against all the shrines on the high places in the cities of Samaria will surely come to pass.
name: The old prophet of Bethel

speaker: jeroboam
text: Now get up, disguise yourself so they will not recognize you as my wife, and go to Shiloh. For Ahijah the prophet is there; it was he who spoke about my kingship over this people.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: jeroboam
text: Take with you ten loaves of bread, some cakes, and a jar of honey, and go to him. He will tell you what will become of the boy.
name: Jeroboam

speaker: god
text: Behold, the wife of Jeroboam is coming to ask you about her son, for he is ill. You are to say such and such to her, because when she arrives, she will be disguised.
name: The LORD

speaker: ahijah
text: Come in, wife of Jeroboam! Why are you disguised? For I have been sent to you with bad news.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: Go, tell Jeroboam that this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘I raised you up from among the people and appointed you ruler over My people Israel.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: I tore the kingdom away from the house of David and gave it to you. But you were not like My servant David, who kept My commandments and followed Me with all his heart, doing only what was right in My eyes.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: You have done more evil than all who came before you. You have proceeded to make for yourself other gods and molten images to provoke Me, and you have flung Me behind your back.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: Because of all this, behold, I am bringing disaster on the house of Jeroboam: I will cut off from Jeroboam every male, both slave and free, in Israel; I will burn up the house of Jeroboam as one burns up dung until it is gone!
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: Anyone belonging to Jeroboam who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.’ For the LORD has spoken.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: As for you, get up and go home. When your feet enter the city, the child will die.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: All Israel will mourn for him and bury him. For this is the only one belonging to Jeroboam who will receive a proper burial, because only in him has the LORD, the God of Israel, found any good in the house of Jeroboam.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: Moreover, the LORD will raise up for Himself a king over Israel who will cut off the house of Jeroboam. This is the day—yes, even today!
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: For the LORD will strike Israel as a reed is shaken in the water. He will uproot Israel from this good land that He gave their fathers, and He will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: ahijah
text: So He will give Israel over on account of the sins Jeroboam has committed and has caused Israel to commit.
name: Ahijah the prophet

speaker: asa
text: Let there be a treaty between me and you, between my father and your father. See, I have sent you a gift of silver and gold. Now go and break your treaty with Baasha king of Israel, so that he will withdraw from me.
name: Asa king of Judah

speaker: god
text: Even though I lifted you out of the dust and made you ruler over My people Israel, you have walked in the way of Jeroboam and have caused My people Israel to sin and to provoke Me to anger by their sins.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: So now I will consume Baasha and his house, and I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat:
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Anyone belonging to Baasha who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.
name: The LORD

speaker: elijah
text: As surely as the LORD lives—the God of Israel before whom I stand—there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!
name: Elijah

speaker: god
text: Leave here, turn eastward, and hide yourself by the Brook of Cherith, east of the Jordan.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: And you are to drink from the brook, and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Get up and go to Zarephath of Sidon, and stay there. Behold, I have commanded a widow there to provide for you.
name: The LORD

speaker: elijah
text: Please bring me a little water in a cup, so that I may drink.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Please bring me a piece of bread.
name: Elijah

speaker: widow-of-zarephath
text: As surely as the LORD your God lives, I have no bread—only a handful of flour in a jar and a little oil in a jug. Look, I am gathering a couple of sticks to take home and prepare a meal for myself and my son, so that we may eat it and die.
name: The widow of Zarephath

speaker: elijah
text: Do not be afraid,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Go and do as you have said. But first make me a small cake of bread from what you have, and bring it out to me. Afterward, make some for yourself and your son,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: for this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘The jar of flour will not be exhausted and the jug of oil will not run dry until the day the LORD sends rain upon the face of the earth.’
name: Elijah

speaker: widow-of-zarephath
text: O man of God,
name: The widow of Zarephath

speaker: widow-of-zarephath
text: what have you done to me? Have you come to remind me of my iniquity and cause the death of my son?
name: The widow of Zarephath

speaker: elijah
text: Give me your son.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: O LORD my God, have You also brought tragedy on this widow who has opened her home to me, by causing her son to die?
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: O LORD my God, please let this boy’s life return to him!
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Look, your son is alive,
name: Elijah

speaker: widow-of-zarephath
text: Now I know that you are a man of God and that the word of the LORD from your mouth is truth.
name: The widow of Zarephath

speaker: god
text: Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the face of the earth.
name: The LORD

speaker: ahab
text: Go throughout the land to every spring and every valley. Perhaps we will find grass to keep the horses and mules alive so that we will not have to destroy any livestock.
name: Ahab

speaker: obadiah
text: Is it you, my lord Elijah?
name: Obadiah

speaker: elijah
text: It is I,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Go tell your master, ‘Elijah is here!’
name: Elijah

speaker: obadiah
text: How have I sinned, that you are handing your servant over to Ahab to put me to death?
name: Obadiah

speaker: obadiah
text: As surely as the LORD your God lives, there is no nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent someone to search for you. When they said, ‘He is not here,’ he made that kingdom or nation swear that they had not found you.
name: Obadiah

speaker: obadiah
text: And now you say, ‘Go tell your master that Elijah is here!’
name: Obadiah

speaker: obadiah
text: I do not know where the Spirit of the LORD may carry you off when I leave you. Then when I go and tell Ahab and he does not find you, he will kill me. But I, your servant, have feared the LORD from my youth.
name: Obadiah

speaker: obadiah
text: Was it not reported to my lord what I did when Jezebel slaughtered the prophets of the LORD? I hid a hundred prophets of the LORD, fifty men per cave, and I provided them with food and water.
name: Obadiah

speaker: obadiah
text: And now you say, ‘Go tell your lord that Elijah is here!’ He will kill me!
name: Obadiah

speaker: elijah
text: As surely as the LORD of Hosts lives, before whom I stand, I will present myself to Ahab today.
name: Elijah

speaker: ahab
text: Is that you, O troubler of Israel?
name: Ahab

speaker: elijah
text: I have not troubled Israel,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: but you and your father’s house have, for you have forsaken the commandments of the LORD and have followed the Baals.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: How long will you waver between two opinions? If the LORD is God, follow Him. But if Baal is God, follow him.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: I am the only remaining prophet of the LORD, but Baal has four hundred and fifty prophets.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Get two bulls for us. Let the prophets of Baal choose one bull for themselves, cut it into pieces, and place it on the wood but not light the fire. And I will prepare the other bull and place it on the wood but not light the fire.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Then you may call on the name of your god, and I will call on the name of the LORD. The God who answers by fire, He is God.
name: Elijah

speaker: israelites
text: What you say is good.
name: The people

speaker: elijah
text: Since you are so numerous, choose for yourselves one bull and prepare it first. Then call on the name of your god, but do not light the fire.
name: Elijah

speaker: prophets-of-baal
text: O Baal, answer us!
name: The prophets of Baal

speaker: elijah
text: Shout louder, for he is a god! Perhaps he is deep in thought, or occupied, or on a journey. Perhaps he is sleeping and must be awakened!
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Come near to me.
name: Elijah

speaker: god
text: Israel shall be your name.
name: The LORD

speaker: elijah
text: Fill four waterpots and pour the water on the offering and on the wood.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Do it a second time,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Do it a third time,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: O LORD, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, let it be known this day that You are God in Israel and that I am Your servant and have done all these things at Your command.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Answer me, O LORD! Answer me, so that this people will know that You, the LORD, are God, and that You have turned their hearts back again.
name: Elijah

speaker: israelites
text: The LORD, He is God! The LORD, He is God!
name: The people

speaker: elijah
text: Seize the prophets of Baal! Do not let a single one escape.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Go up, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Go and look toward the sea,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah-servant
text: There is nothing there.
name: Elijah's servant

speaker: elijah
text: Go back.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah-servant
text: There is a cloud as small as a man’s hand rising from the sea.
name: Elijah's servant

speaker: elijah
text: Go and tell Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’
name: Elijah

speaker: jezebel
text: May the gods deal with me, and ever so severely, if by this time tomorrow I do not make your life like the lives of those you killed!
name: Jezebel

speaker: elijah
text: I have had enough, LORD,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Take my life, for I am no better than my fathers.
name: Elijah

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Get up and eat.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Get up and eat, or the journey will be too much for you.
name: The angel of the LORD

speaker: god
text: What are you doing here, Elijah?
name: The LORD

speaker: elijah
text: I have been very zealous for the LORD, the God of Hosts,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: but the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well.
name: Elijah

speaker: god
text: Go out and stand on the mountain before the LORD. Behold, the LORD is about to pass by.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: What are you doing here, Elijah?
name: The LORD

speaker: elijah
text: I have been very zealous for the LORD, the God of Hosts,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: but the Israelites have forsaken Your covenant, torn down Your altars, and killed Your prophets with the sword. I am the only one left, and they are seeking my life as well.
name: Elijah

speaker: god
text: Go back by the way you came, and go to the Desert of Damascus. When you arrive, you are to anoint Hazael as king over Aram.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: You are also to anoint Jehu son of Nimshi as king over Israel and Elisha son of Shaphat from Abel-meholah to succeed you as prophet.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Then Jehu will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Hazael, and Elisha will put to death whoever escapes the sword of Jehu.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Nevertheless, I have reserved seven thousand in Israel—all whose knees have not bowed to Baal and whose mouths have not kissed him.
name: The LORD

speaker: elisha
text: Please let me kiss my father and mother goodbye, and then I will follow you.
name: Elisha

speaker: elijah
text: Go on back,
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: for what have I done to you?
name: Elijah

speaker: ben-hadad
text: This is what Ben-hadad says: ‘Your silver and gold are mine, and your best wives and children are mine!’
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: ahab
text: Just as you say, my lord the king: I am yours, along with all that I have.
name: Ahab

speaker: ben-hadad
text: This is what Ben-hadad says: ‘I have sent to you to demand your silver, your gold, your wives, and your children.
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: ben-hadad
text: But about this time tomorrow I will send my servants to search your palace and the houses of your servants. They will seize and carry away all that is precious to you.’
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: ahab
text: Please take note and see that this man is looking for trouble, for when he demanded my wives, my children, my silver, and my gold, I did not deny him.
name: Ahab

speaker: elders-of-israel
text: Do not listen to him or consent to his terms.
name: The elders

speaker: ahab
text: Tell my lord the king, ‘All that you demanded of your servant the first time I will do, but this thing I cannot do.’
name: Ahab

speaker: ben-hadad
text: May the gods deal with me, and ever so severely, if enough dust remains of Samaria for each of my men to have a handful.
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: ahab
text: Tell him: ‘The one putting on his armor should not boast like one taking it off.’
name: Ahab

speaker: ben-hadad
text: Take your positions.
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Do you see this entire great army? Behold, I will deliver it into your hand this very day, and you will know that I am the LORD.’
name: A prophet

speaker: ahab
text: By whom?
name: Ahab

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘By the young officers of the district governors.’
name: A prophet

speaker: ahab
text: Who will start the battle?
name: Ahab

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: You will,
name: A prophet

speaker: aramean-scouts
text: Men are marching out of Samaria.
name: The Aramean scouts

speaker: ben-hadad
text: If they have marched out in peace,
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: ben-hadad
text: take them alive. Even if they have marched out for war, take them alive.
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: Go and strengthen your position, and take note what you must do, for in the spring the king of Aram will come up against you.
name: A prophet

speaker: aramean-servants
text: Their gods are gods of the hills. That is why they prevailed over us. Instead, we should fight them on the plains; surely then we will prevail.
name: Ben-hadad's servants

speaker: aramean-servants
text: So do this: Dismiss all the kings from their positions and replace them with other officers.
name: Ben-hadad's servants

speaker: aramean-servants
text: And you must raise an army like the one you have lost—horse for horse and chariot for chariot—so we can fight the Israelites on the plain, where we will surely prevail.
name: Ben-hadad's servants

speaker: unnamed-prophet
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Because the Arameans think the LORD is a god of the hills and not of the valleys, I will deliver all this great army into your hand. Then you will know that I am the LORD.’
name: A prophet

speaker: aramean-servants
text: Look now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful. Let us go out to the king of Israel with sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads. Perhaps he will spare your life.
name: Ben-hadad's servants

speaker: aramean-servants
text: Your servant Ben-hadad says, ‘Please spare my life.’
name: Ben-hadad's servants

speaker: ahab
text: Is he still alive? He is my brother.
name: Ahab

speaker: aramean-servants
text: Yes, your brother Ben-hadad.
name: Ben-hadad's servants

speaker: ahab
text: Go and get him!
name: Ahab

speaker: ben-hadad
text: I will restore the cities my father took from your father; you may set up your own marketplaces in Damascus, as my father did in Samaria.
name: Ben-hadad

speaker: ahab
text: By this treaty I release you,
name: Ahab

speaker: son-of-prophet
text: Strike me, please!
name: One of the sons of the prophets

speaker: son-of-prophet
text: Because you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD, as soon as you depart from me a lion will kill you.
name: One of the sons of the prophets

speaker: son-of-prophet
text: Strike me, please!
name: One of the sons of the prophets

speaker: son-of-prophet
text: Your servant had marched out into the middle of the battle, when suddenly a man came over with a captive and told me, ‘Guard this man! If he goes missing for any reason, your life will be exchanged for his life, or you will weigh out a talent of silver.’
name: One of the sons of the prophets

speaker: son-of-prophet
text: But while your servant was busy here and there, the man disappeared.
name: One of the sons of the prophets

speaker: ahab
text: So shall your judgment be; you have pronounced it on yourself.
name: Ahab

speaker: son-of-prophet
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘Because you have let slip from your hand the man I had devoted to destruction, your life will be exchanged for his life, and your people for his people.’
name: One of the sons of the prophets

speaker: ahab
text: Give me your vineyard to use as a vegetable garden, since it is next to my palace. I will give you a better vineyard in its place—or if you prefer, I will give you its value in silver.
name: Ahab

speaker: naboth
text: The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.
name: Naboth

speaker: naboth
text: I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.
name: Naboth

speaker: jezebel
text: Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?
name: Jezebel

speaker: ahab
text: Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and told him, ‘Give me your vineyard for silver, or if you wish, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ And he replied, ‘I will not give you my vineyard!’
name: Ahab

speaker: jezebel
text: Do you not reign over Israel? Get up, eat some food, and be cheerful, for I will get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.
name: Jezebel

speaker: jezebel
text: Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people.
name: Jezebel

speaker: jezebel
text: But seat two scoundrels opposite him and have them testify, ‘You have cursed both God and the king!’ Then take him out and stone him to death.
name: Jezebel

speaker: scoundrels
text: Naboth has cursed both God and the king!
name: The two scoundrels

speaker: elders-of-jezreel
text: Naboth has been stoned to death.
name: The elders of Jezreel

speaker: jezebel
text: Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who refused to give it to you for silver. For Naboth is no longer alive, but dead.
name: Jezebel

speaker: god
text: Get up and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria. See, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, of which he has gone to take possession.
name: The LORD

speaker: god
text: Tell him that this is what the LORD says: ‘Have you not murdered a man and seized his land?’ Then tell him that this is also what the LORD says: ‘In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, there also the dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!’
name: The LORD

speaker: ahab
text: So you have found me out, my enemy.
name: Ahab

speaker: elijah
text: I have found you out because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the LORD.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants; I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel, both slave and free.
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like that of Baasha son of Ahijah, because you have provoked My anger and caused Israel to sin.’
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: And the LORD also speaks concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’
name: Elijah

speaker: elijah
text: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs, and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air.
name: Elijah

speaker: god
text: Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me? Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity during his days, but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son.
name: The LORD

speaker: ahab
text: Do you not know that Ramoth-gilead is ours, but we have failed to take it from the hand of the king of Aram?
name: Ahab

speaker: ahab
text: Will you go with me to fight against Ramoth-gilead?
name: Ahab

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: I am like you, my people are your people, and my horses are your horses.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Please inquire first for the word of the LORD.
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: ahab
text: Should I go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should I refrain?
name: Ahab

speaker: prophets
text: Go up,
name: The four hundred prophets

speaker: prophets
text: and the Lord will deliver it into the hand of the king.
name: The four hundred prophets

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: Is there not still a prophet of the LORD here of whom we can inquire?
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: ahab
text: There is still one man who can ask the LORD, but I hate him because he never prophesies anything good for me, but only bad. He is Micaiah son of Imlah.
name: Ahab

speaker: jehoshaphat
text: The king should not say that!
name: Jehoshaphat

speaker: ahab
text: Bring Micaiah son of Imlah at once.
name: Ahab

speaker: zedekiah
text: This is what the LORD says: ‘With these you shall gore the Arameans until they are finished off.’
name: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah

speaker: prophets
text: Go up to Ramoth-gilead and prosper, for the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.
name: The four hundred prophets

speaker: messenger
text: Behold now, with one accord the words of the prophets are favorable to the king. So please let your words be like theirs, and speak favorably.
name: The messenger

speaker: micaiah
text: As surely as the LORD lives, I will speak whatever the LORD tells me.
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: Micaiah, should we go to war against Ramoth-gilead, or should we refrain?
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: Go up and triumph,
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: for the LORD will give it into the hand of the king.
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: How many times must I make you swear not to tell me anything but the truth in the name of the LORD?
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: I saw all Israel scattered on the hills like sheep without a shepherd. And the LORD said, ‘These people have no master; let each one return home in peace.’
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: Did I not tell you that he never prophesies good for me, but only bad?
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: Therefore hear the word of the LORD: I saw the LORD sitting on His throne, and all the host of heaven standing by Him on His right and on His left.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: And the LORD said, ‘Who will entice Ahab to march up and fall at Ramoth-gilead?’ And one suggested this, and another that.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: Then a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘By what means?’ asked the LORD.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: And he replied, ‘I will go out and be a lying spirit in the mouths of all his prophets.’ ‘You will surely entice him and prevail,’ said the LORD. ‘Go and do it.’
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: So you see, the LORD has put a lying spirit in the mouths of all these prophets of yours, and the LORD has pronounced disaster against you.
name: Micaiah

speaker: zedekiah
text: Which way did the Spirit of the LORD go when He departed from me to speak with you?
name: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah

speaker: micaiah
text: You will soon see, on that day when you go and hide in an inner room.
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: Take Micaiah and return him to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son,
name: Ahab

speaker: ahab
text: and tell them that this is what the king says: ‘Put this man in prison and feed him only bread and water until I return safely.’
name: Ahab

speaker: micaiah
text: If you ever return safely, the LORD has not spoken through me.
name: Micaiah

speaker: micaiah
text: Take heed, all you people!
name: Micaiah

speaker: ahab
text: I will disguise myself and go into battle, but you wear your royal robes.
name: Ahab

speaker: aram-king
text: Do not fight with anyone, small or great, except the king of Israel.
name: The king of Aram

speaker: chariot-commanders
text: Surely this is the king of Israel!
name: The chariot commanders

speaker: ahab
text: Turn around and take me out of the battle, for I am badly wounded!
name: Ahab

speaker: ahaziah
text: Let my servants sail with your servants,
name: Ahaziah
